title: Ken Zeff
description: Posted a photo on social media wearing an Atlanta Public Schools pride tee shirt with students also wearing pride tees.
body:
# Ken Zeff

- Posted [a photo](https://restoration-news.com/getContentAsset/7547c403-769d-4226-9f17-0b7758d3ffee/347abc5f-3708-4979-a52d-d9fb8570b282/GA-Atlanta-Zeff-pride-tee.png?language=en) on social media wearing an Atlanta Public Schools pride tee shirt with students also wearing pride tees.
